summary: 27-year-old male climber fell ~50-60 ft on the Owl Route at The Dome, Boulder Canyon, striking rocks; RMRG members scouting a nearby training site were on scene within minutes; medevac helicopter cancelled as his condition improved; transported to Boulder Community Hospital conscious and communicative.
location: The Dome, Owl Route, Boulder Canyon (40000 block Boulder Canyon Dr)
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group + AMR + Boulder Emergency Squad + Four Mile Fire + Boulder OSMP Rangers + Boulder County Sheriff
notes: BCSO case 17-4573. Rescue call ~10:38 a.m. Dedupe: distinct from id 2858, a separate Pagoda Mountain fall on the same date.
